grammar_title: 情态动词1:义务与建议(must / have to / should / ought to / mustn't / needn't / don't have to)
source: 外研社(新标准)必修第二册 Unit 1 Using language:情态动词(1)义务与建议。句子地道、围绕饮食/餐桌主题,答案唯一(干扰项语义相反或不成立)。

points.point: must / have to(表义务:内在必要 vs 外在要求)
points.overview: must 多表说话人自己强烈的必要或坚持;have to 多表规则、医嘱、客观情况等外部要求。两者都表示"必须做",在肯定的义务语境里成立,而 mustn't(禁止)、needn't / don't have to(不必)与义务相反。

points.point: should / ought to(表建议:应该做)
points.overview: should 和 ought to 都表示"应该",给出建议或忠告;语气比 must 弱。其相反面是 shouldn't(不该这么做),而 mustn't(禁止)、needn't(不必)在给出"应该做某事"的语境里不成立。

points.point: mustn't / needn't / don't have to(禁止 vs 不必)
points.overview: mustn't = 一定不要、禁止(不允许、危险或失礼);needn't / don't have to = 不必、没必要(做不做都行)。三者意义不同:禁止≠不必≠必须(must),据语境选唯一成立项。

questions.stem: This soup is wonderful — you ____ try it before it gets cold!
questions.explanation: 说话人热情坚持对方一定要尝,用 must;禁止/不必/不能都与语境相反。

questions.stem: We've run out of honey, so I ____ remember to buy some on the way home.
questions.explanation: 说话人提醒自己务必记得,内在必要用 must;其余表示不必或禁止,不合逻辑。

questions.stem: The cake smells amazing. I really ____ ask the chef for the recipe.
questions.explanation: 出于自己的强烈意愿"一定要问",用 must。

questions.stem: Grandma cooked all afternoon, so we ____ thank her for the lovely meal.
questions.explanation: 说话人觉得理应如此、非做不可,用 must;不必/禁止都不成立。

questions.stem: You ____ taste this blue cheese — I'm sure you'll love its strong flavour.
questions.explanation: 强烈推荐对方一定要尝,用 must;mustn't/shouldn't 是反对,needn't 是不必。

questions.stem: I ____ say, this is the best noodle shop I have ever been to.
questions.explanation: 固定说法 I must say(我得说),表达强烈看法,用 must。

questions.stem: It's late and I'm starving — we ____ find somewhere to eat right now.
questions.explanation: 情况紧迫、非吃不可,内在强烈必要用 must。

questions.stem: These dumplings are so good that I ____ have a second bowl.
questions.explanation: 说话人忍不住、一定要再来一碗,用 must。

questions.stem: Before I forget it, I ____ write down Mum's secret sauce recipe.
questions.explanation: 提醒自己务必记下来,内在必要用 must。

questions.stem: You ____ visit that little bakery; their fresh bread is unbeatable.
questions.explanation: 热情建议对方一定要去,用 must;其余与语境相反。

questions.stem: To get a table at that restaurant, you ____ book a week in advance.
questions.explanation: 这是餐厅的客观要求(外部规定),用 have to;禁止/不必/不能都不合理。

questions.stem: I'm allergic to nuts, so I ____ check every label before I eat.
questions.explanation: 因身体情况这一客观原因而不得不做,用 have to。

questions.stem: The school rule says students ____ finish their vegetables before dessert.
questions.explanation: 学校规定这一外部要求,用 have to。

questions.stem: My doctor told me I ____ cut down on salt because of my blood pressure.
questions.explanation: 医嘱是外部要求,转述时用 have to。

questions.stem: The recipe says you ____ heat the oil before adding the chillies.
questions.explanation: 食谱的步骤要求(客观条件),用 have to。

questions.stem: Because the canteen closes at two, we ____ have lunch a bit earlier today.
questions.explanation: 受客观情况限制不得不提前,用 have to。

questions.stem: In some cultures, guests ____ take off their shoes before a family dinner.
questions.explanation: 当地风俗这一外部要求,用 have to。

questions.stem: The waiter said we ____ pay at the counter, not at the table.
questions.explanation: 餐厅规定(外部要求),用 have to。

questions.stem: Since every shop was closed, we ____ cook with whatever was left in the fridge.
questions.explanation: 客观情况使然(没别的选择),用 have to。

questions.stem: All kitchen staff ____ wash their hands before they start work — it's the rule.
questions.explanation: 工作规定这一外部要求,用 have to。

questions.stem: If you want to stay healthy, you ____ eat more fresh fruit and vegetables.
questions.explanation: 给出健康建议"应该多吃",用 should;其余是反对或禁止。

questions.stem: You look tired. You ____ have a proper breakfast every morning.
questions.explanation: 友善建议对方应该这么做,用 should。

questions.stem: These soft drinks have too much sugar; you ____ choose water instead.
questions.explanation: 建议改选更健康的水,用 should。

questions.stem: If the soup tastes a little flat, you ____ add a pinch more salt.
questions.explanation: 提出做法建议,用 should。

questions.stem: When in Rome, you ____ try the local food and follow local customs.
questions.explanation: 建议入乡随俗,用 should。

questions.stem: To make the steak tender, you ____ cook it over a high heat first.
questions.explanation: 给出烹饪建议,用 should。

questions.stem: You ____ wash the vegetables carefully before you put them in the pot.
questions.explanation: 建议应当先洗净,用 should。

questions.stem: If you don't like spicy food, you ____ ask the chef to make it milder.
questions.explanation: 提出解决建议,用 should。

questions.stem: We ____ eat a little more slowly so that we can really enjoy the meal.
questions.explanation: 温和建议大家应该这么做,用 should。

questions.stem: If you feel hungry between meals, you ____ keep some healthy snacks nearby.
questions.explanation: 给出实用建议,用 should。

questions.stem: Your fridge is almost empty; you ____ do a big shop this weekend.
questions.explanation: 建议"应该"去采购,用 ought to,与 should 同义。

questions.stem: Such a kind and skilful chef — we ____ leave him a nice review online.
questions.explanation: 理应这么做的建议,用 ought to。

questions.stem: If you keep eating so much fried food, you ____ think about your health.
questions.explanation: 提出忠告"应该考虑",用 ought to。

questions.stem: This cheese is clearly going off; you ____ throw it away now.
questions.explanation: 建议应当扔掉,用 ought to。

questions.stem: Guests are coming for dinner, so we ____ tidy the kitchen first.
questions.explanation: 建议理应先收拾,用 ought to。

questions.stem: If you want to learn to cook, you ____ start with a few simple recipes.
questions.explanation: 给出学习建议,用 ought to。

questions.stem: The bread is freshest now, so we ____ eat it today rather than tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 建议应当今天吃,用 ought to。

questions.stem: You ____ taste the sauce before you add any more salt to it.
questions.explanation: 给出做法建议,用 ought to。

questions.stem: Since you are a vegetarian, you ____ tell the waiter about it in advance.
questions.explanation: 建议应当提前说明,用 ought to。

questions.stem: When a host invites us to dinner, we ____ thank them with a small gift.
questions.explanation: 礼仪建议"理应"如此,用 ought to。

questions.stem: These wild berries are poisonous, so you ____ eat them.
questions.explanation: 有毒、绝对不能吃,表禁止用 mustn't;不必/必须都不合逻辑。

questions.stem: You ____ touch the hot pot with your bare hands; you'll burn yourself.
questions.explanation: 危险、千万不要,表禁止用 mustn't。

questions.stem: We ____ be late for the wedding dinner; it would be very rude.
questions.explanation: 失礼、一定不要迟到,表禁止用 mustn't。

questions.stem: You ____ put metal plates in the microwave — it is really dangerous.
questions.explanation: 危险、绝不可这么做,用 mustn't。

questions.stem: Diners ____ smoke inside the restaurant; it is simply not allowed.
questions.explanation: 明令不允许,表禁止用 mustn't。

questions.stem: You ____ tell Grandma the soup was too salty; it would hurt her feelings.
questions.explanation: 千万别说出口,表禁止/劝阻用 mustn't。

questions.stem: Young children ____ play with the sharp kitchen knives.
questions.explanation: 为安全绝对禁止,用 mustn't。

questions.stem: You ____ leave the gas on after you finish cooking; it's not safe.
questions.explanation: 不安全、绝不可,用 mustn't。

questions.stem: There's plenty of food in the fridge, so you ____ cook anything tonight.
questions.explanation: 没必要做,表不必用 needn't;禁止/必须都不合语境。

questions.stem: The meal has already been paid for, so you ____ bring any money.
questions.explanation: 无需带钱,表不必用 needn't。

questions.stem: It's only a casual lunch, so you ____ wear anything fancy.
questions.explanation: 无需穿正式,表不必用 needn't。

questions.stem: Mum said, "You ____ try the stinky tofu if you really don't want to."
questions.explanation: 不想吃就不必吃,表不必用 needn't。

questions.stem: We have enough chairs, so we ____ borrow any from the neighbours.
questions.explanation: 无需去借,表不必用 needn't。

questions.stem: The dish is very forgiving, so you ____ follow the recipe exactly.
questions.explanation: 不必严格照做,表不必用 needn't。

questions.stem: Lunch is free for students today, so you ____ pay for it.
questions.explanation: 免费、无需付钱,表不必用 don't have to。

questions.stem: There is still some bread left, so we ____ buy more this morning.
questions.explanation: 还有剩、不必再买,用 don't have to。

questions.stem: It's a buffet, so you ____ wait to be served at the table.
questions.explanation: 自助餐无需等人上菜,用 don't have to。

questions.stem: She isn't coming for dinner tonight, so we ____ cook for her.
questions.explanation: 她不来、无需为她做,用 don't have to。

questions.stem: The soup is quite mild, so you ____ worry about it being too spicy.
questions.explanation: 不必担心,用 don't have to。

questions.stem: We've already booked a table, so we ____ queue outside the restaurant.
questions.explanation: 已订位、无需排队,用 don't have to。
